_about: proto-kitchen (Zafar's rapid prototype, 1 Nov): the baking station's own data (js/cook/stations/baking.js; the card is recipes.baking in data/cook.json, its rows filled from the plan picked here). Zafar's turn-by-turn design (prototype-notes-2026-11-01.md 'Baking'; cook-baking-eggs.md end note): Nani gives one instruction at a time, each tap tips the jar or bag a bit more. A step: id (the container), amt (little: one tap, it stops, 'that's good'; lot: tap until lotTaps, 'enough'; more: a little, tap, 'still a little more', tap, 'enough'; jug: tap until `units` quarter cups in the measuring jug, its lines at a quarter, half, full, one and a half and two and a half, no numbers), parts (the card row's words, through the language engine). `plans` by level (one picked at random); the decoys (how many other containers stand in the row) are the central rules' (data/rules.json levels.decoys: 1-4, a lookalike at L4; S18); bakeMs the oven's time; `palette` the art colours.

station.name: Baking
station.verb: Nani's turns: a little, a lot; then the oven
station.goal: Nani says one thing at a time. Tap what she names; then tap it to tip it, a bit more each tap, until she says that's enough. Then the oven: open it, put the naan in, take it out when she says it's ready.

phases.mix: Tap what Nani names. Each tap tips it a bit more.
phases.oven: Tap the oven to open it, then the naan. Take it out when it's ready.

palette._note: S18 (s18-g-baking): the wall, tiles, counter, jug, mound and oven are pictures now (scene, items); what is left is the bake ring, the steam and the drawn drops for the containers with no stream picture yet (salt, yoghurt, ghee)

kitchen.about: Sprint 18 prep (7 Nov): see data/stations/eggs.json kitchen.about (the same shape in every kitchen game). The station's own station/mechanic keys are untouched; its words gained three jug amounts (so the gap list reads them).

recipe.ref: data/cook.json recipes.baking (no slots: the plan is picked from mechanic.levels[].plans by level)

amounts.more: a little, tap, 'still a little more', tap, 'enough'
amounts.jug: tap until `units` quarter cups are in the measuring jug (its five lines, no numbers)

recipe._levels: The plans themselves (which container, how much, its engine parts) stay in mechanic.levels[].plans, as the station reads them.

scene.view: E side-on counter; the oven is its own close-up
scene._bg: BK cut at crop_y 146 so the worktop's front edge lands at y 469.8 (wanted 470). BK is a kept best try: its tiles and marble lean peach (run log).

cat.note: A named placeholder (the 1 Nov mock-up's crop of Simba) until his own peek is drawn.

oven._note: one 840x643 canvas, top-left aligned on the cabinet frame: a swap changes only the glow or the door

mixBowl._note: contents rise by turn: the first picture is empty, the last is the dough after the final instruction; one canvas

jug._at: the jug's base (origin bottom centre), level with the bowl's foot
jug._lineAt: key = quarter cups (1 = a quarter ... 10 = two and a half), value = the line's height as a fraction of the jug picture from its TOP; five evenly drawn lines, no numbers. The game reveals a full jug through a rising mask up to the line, never a proportional fill.
jug.replaces: the drawn jug and its drawn fill

tray._note: an empty steel tray; flagged by artcolour (warm steel reads tan, 19%): the pots and bowls share that warm steel

naan._note: on its tray, registered with the tray: in the oven by the ring's progress; the tray alone is items.tray

naanOut._note: taken out of the oven, alone

containers._pour: liquid: poured as a column, the rest as drops; pour: the palette key of the drawn drops where items.streams has no picture

streams._note: the shared pour columns (WS), stretched from a container's lip to the bowl or jug; yoghurt, salt and ghee have none yet (the drawn drops stay)

ph-half.note: adh, recorded; CHAI-67's word moment names it

lines.instruction: DoIt v.put-in with the item (and the amount's line)
lines._note: Lang.line keys the station says today; the amounts of the jug are the word moment's job (CHAI-67)

wordMoment.call: UI.wordMoment(ids, settings.wordMoment): the kit's call with this game's pieces (the generalised call is asked of the kit's owner in build/reports/s18-g-baking.md; until it lands the call plays chai's moment only and this one is skipped)
wordMoment._pair: L3's first jug round asks a cup of flour and half a cup of water or milk (mechanic.levels[2].plans): the two the moment shows, side by side, before it names either (STD-A3-03)
wordMoment._measures: each measure the jug, empty, then its full picture revealed from the bottom up to its line (items.jug.lineAt: 2 quarter cups 0.672, 4 quarter cups 0.532, from the picture's top); fill, the word moment's share of the inside (the jug's inside about 0.12 to 0.90 of the picture: (0.90 - lineAt) / 0.78); placeholders until ART-38 (a vessel tilted into a side-on measure, empty, half and full)
wordMoment.ref: docs/design-language/art-plans/s17-art1-art-plan.md §1.1; baking's own word moment art (ART-37/38) is a placeholder this sprint
wordMoment.note: adh is recorded; the other four are grey English until Mum gives them
